jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Donor Recognition
jokes.joke: I went to a charity auction where the guy running the fundraiser said, 'Come on, folks, give until it hurts!' I donated fifty bucks. He came over and asked if I could make it a hundred. I said, 'No, fifty already hurts.' He said, 'Imagine how the children feel.' I said, 'Do they know you're talking to me like this?'

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: Silent Auction
jokes.joke: I donated my grandfather's watch to a silent auction fundraiser. Just dropped it off, filled out the form, left. Came back three hours later for the closing bids and the watch was gone. Not won. Gone. Nobody outbid anyone, the table was just empty, like the raffle had an afterlife. I didn't support a good cause, I opened a missing persons case for a Rolex.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Charity Gala
jokes.joke: I went to a charity fundraiser last week where the auctioneer treated generosity like a hostage negotiation. I blinked during the silent auction and suddenly owned a $400 signed toaster. When I tried to walk away, a volunteer blocked the exit with a clipboard and whispered, "Are you really going to let the turtles down, Greg?" My name isn't even Greg—I just panicked and tipped twenty percent to escape.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Charity Ambush
jokes.joke: I went to a charity fundraiser last month and the volunteer was so pushy he didn’t take no for an answer. He followed me from the silent auction to the parking lot, then texted me from the next table at dinner. By the time I got home I’d pledged my spare kidney, the title to my car, and the last two years of my tax returns. He still sent a follow-up: “Just checking if you’ve reconsidered the matching gift.”

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Neighborly Pressure
jokes.joke: I knew my new neighbor was friendly when he brought over cookies. I knew he was pushy when he stood in my doorway watching me eat them. Every bite came with coaching: 'Try the one with chocolate chips!' By the fourth cookie he was yelling, 'Come on, you're leaving snacks on the table!' I wasn't making a friend, I was being sponsored.
